jobs.description: In a nutshell We’re looking for a hands-on, creative Content Creator Working Student to help tell our story. You’ll own our employer branding organic social content from start to finish brainstorming bold concepts, shooting, editing, and hitting the publish button. Working alongside recruiters, campaign managers, and designers, you’ll turn daily life behind the scenes into engaging content that stops top-talent scroll and gets them excited to join our ride. Tricks of the trade Master the End-to-End Creative Process: Pitch bold ideas, direct colleagues on camera, shoot mobile-first, and cut the final edit. Turn Raw Stories into High-Engagement Assets: Capture real, behind-the-scenes moments and turn everyday footage into clips that our target persona actually wants to watch on LinkedIn and Instagram. Refine Visual Craft & Brand Consistency: Sharpen your eye for pacing, color, and smart branding to make every piece of content look pro and cohesive. Your superpowers Currently enrolled student: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Media, Film, Communication, Design, or a related creative field. Strong short-form editing chops: Hands-on experience with Adobe Suite and CapCut, with a strong feel for hooks, retention editing, tempo, sound design, and color grading/color theory. Comfortable behind the lens: Confident shooting content on both a smartphone and a camera, with a solid eye for framing, lighting, and composition. Systems thinker: You know how to build organized project files that can be easily adapted and reused across different social platforms. Language & Communication: Fluent in English (Dutch, French, or German is a plus). Availability : Available for at least 16 hrs p/w (the more, the merrier!) for a minimum of 6 months. Bonus: Working knowledge of After Effects for animations/graphics, or photography skills. Don’t tick all the boxes yet?
